name: Jefferson County, TX
findings: Jefferson County has 769 nonprofit organizations. 263 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 205 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jefferson County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 152 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list public events
observations.text: 1 health care organization here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 121 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
